title: Your launch video shouldn't explain your product
caption: Your launch video shouldn't explain your product first. It should make people care first.

slides.headline: Your launch video shouldn't explain your product.
slides.accentText: It should make people care first.

slides.title: Most startup launch videos follow the same pattern:
slides.footer: And they miss the part that matters most.

slides.headline: People don't care because your product exists.
slides.body: They care because there's a problem in their world they want solved.

slides.title: Sell the problem before the product.
items: Show the frustration your customer lives with
Show what changes when the problem is solved
Show why this product needed to exist
slides.footer: The product becomes interesting when people understand what it changes.

slides.rightBody: Makes people want to understand it.
slides.footer: Those are two completely different jobs.

slides.title: Stop making every launch look like a SaaS launch.
slides.footer: Different products. Different founders. Same creative direction.

slides.title: Your launch should reflect:
items: The people you're solving it for
The founder's reason for building it
The change you want to create

slides.headline: A launch video should create curiosity.
slides.body: Let the demo explain the mechanics. Let the launch make people care.
